title: DoS GoldenEye Attack
mitre_source: Borisenko et al. (2022), DOI: 10.1109/SYNCHROINFO55067.2022.9840920, Table II
source_note: observed_features: top-5 mean |SHAP| over the training reference set of the named Layer 1 variant. Not shown to the model by default.
description: GoldenEye is a DoS tool that performs a layer 7 DoS attack by exhausting the application pool resources. It uses Keep-Alive and Cache-Control headers to persist connections.

network_indicators.traffic_pattern: Persistent HTTP connections with high request rates designed to exhaust server-side resources.

mitigation.name: Filter Network Traffic
mitigation.action: Implement rate limiting and connection limits per source IP.

mitigation.name: Exploit Protection
mitigation.action: Use WAF to detect and block GoldenEye-specific request patterns.

false_positive_hints: Aggressive web crawlers or misconfigured client applications might generate similar high-frequency request patterns.
